title: Hindering Apprehension or Prosecution
grade_or_penalty: 3rd degree when the underlying offense is a 1st or 2nd degree crime; 4th degree for 3rd or 4th degree crimes; disorderly persons otherwise
key_points: Hindering another's (or one's own) detection, apprehension, investigation or prosecution by harboring, providing a weapon or disguise, concealing evidence, warning, or giving false information.
